recipes.title: Tomato and chickpea stew
recipes.summary: A warming one-pot stew with tomatoes, chickpeas and spinach, finished with fragrant spices.

ingredients.rawText: knob of butter, if you like
ingredients.name: butter

steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tinned tomatoes, chickpeas and vegetable stock. Bring to a simmer.
Cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper.
Finish with a knob of butter, if you like, stirring until melted.

recipes.title: Spiced lentil dal with ghee
recipes.summary: A creamy red lentil dal infused with aromatic spices and finished with ghee.
steps: Rinse the red lentils and place in a pot with water and turmeric.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 25 minutes until soft and creamy.
Meanwhile, heat the ghee in a frying pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin seeds and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Stir in the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the garam masala and cook for 30 seconds.
Pour the spiced mixture into the cooked lentils and stir well.
Season with salt and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander if desired.

recipes.title: Crispy panko fish fillets
recipes.summary: Golden fish fillets coated in crispy panko breadcrumbs, baked until crunchy.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Set up three shallow bowls: one with flour, one with beaten eggs, and one with panko mixed with garlic powder and paprika.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Coat each fillet in flour, then dip in egg, then press into the panko mixture.
Place the coated fillets on a baking tray drizzled with vegetable oil.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden and crispy.
Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Brinjal and tomato curry
recipes.summary: A rich South Indian curry with tender brinjal in a spiced tomato gravy.
steps: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan and fry the brinjal cubes until lightly browned. Set aside.
Heat the remaining oil in the same pan and add mustard seeds until they pop.
Add curry leaves, onion and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, chilli powder and coriander powder. Cook for 5 minutes until tomatoes soften.
Return the brinjal to the pan and add water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the brinjal is tender and the gravy has thickened.
Season with salt and serve.

recipes.title: Honey garlic chicken thighs
recipes.summary: Tender chicken thighs glazed with a sticky honey garlic sauce.
steps: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Heat vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken thighs skin-side down and cook for 6 minutes until golden.
Flip and cook for another 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix honey, soy sauce, garlic, rice vinegar and sesame oil in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chicken and reduce heat to medium.
Simmer for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions if desired.

recipes.title: Baked salmon with lemon and dill
recipes.summary: Simple baked salmon fillets with fresh lemon and dill.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Place salmon fillets on a baking tray lined with parchment.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Top each fillet with lemon slices and fresh dill.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Beef and vegetable stir-fry
recipes.summary: Quick beef stir-fry with crisp vegetables in a savoury sauce.
steps: Mix cornflour with water to make a slurry.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over high heat.
Add the beef and stir-fry for 3 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
Heat the remaining oil and add garlic and ginger. Cook for 30 seconds.
Add red pepper and broccoli and stir-fry for 4 minutes.
Return the beef to the wok.
Add soy sauce, oyster sauce and cornflour slurry. Stir well.
Cook for 2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats everything.

recipes.title: Mushroom risotto
recipes.summary: Creamy risotto with sautéed mushrooms and parmesan cheese.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan and sauté the mushrooms for 5 minutes. Set aside.
In the same pan, melt half the butter and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice and cook for 2 minutes until translucent.
Pour in the white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the hot stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until the rice is creamy and al dente.
Stir in the cooked mushrooms, remaining butter and parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Thai green curry with chicken
recipes.summary: Fragrant green curry with chicken, vegetables and coconut milk.
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the green curry paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes until sealed.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add red pepper and green beans and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in fish sauce and palm sugar.
Simmer for 5 more minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Tear in Thai basil leaves and stir.
Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Spaghetti carbonara
recipes.summary: Classic Roman pasta with egg, cheese and crispy pancetta.
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
Meanwhile, fry the pancetta in a large pan over medium heat until crispy, about 5 minutes.
In a bowl, whisk together egg yolks, whole egg, parmesan and plenty of black pepper.
Drain the pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Remove the pan from heat and add the hot pasta to the pancetta.
Pour the egg mixture over the pasta and toss quickly, adding pasta water a little at a time until creamy.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan and black pepper.

recipes.title: Lamb kofta with mint yoghurt
recipes.summary: Spiced lamb meatballs served with cooling mint yoghurt sauce.
steps: Mix lamb mince, onion, garlic, cumin, coriander powder, paprika, parsley, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Form into 12 small kofta shapes.
Heat olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Cook the kofta for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix yoghurt with chopped mint and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Season the yoghurt sauce with salt.
Serve the kofta with the mint yoghurt sauce.

recipes.title: Roasted vegetable couscous
recipes.summary: Warm couscous salad with roasted Mediterranean vegetables and herbs.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Toss courgette, red pepper, aubergine and red onion with 2 tablespoons olive oil, cumin, salt and pepper.
Spread on a baking tray and roast for 25 minutes until tender and golden.
Meanwhile, place couscous in a large bowl and pour over the hot vegetable stock.
Cover and leave for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Stir in the remaining olive oil and roasted vegetables.
Add chopped coriander and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Season and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Pork chops with apple sauce
recipes.summary: Pan-fried pork chops served with homemade apple sauce.
steps: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Cook the pork chops for 5-6 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
In a small saucepan, combine apples, water, sugar and cinnamon.
Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the apples break down into a sauce.
Mash with a fork to desired consistency.
Serve the pork chops with the warm apple sauce.

recipes.title: Miso glazed aubergine
recipes.summary: Tender aubergine with a sweet and savoury miso glaze.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Score the flesh of the aubergine halves in a criss-cross pattern.
Brush with vegetable oil and place cut-side down on a baking tray.
Bake for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix miso, mirin, sugar and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Remove aubergines from oven and turn cut-side up.
Brush generously with the miso glaze.
Return to oven and bake for 10 more minutes until golden and caramelised.
Garnish with sesame seeds and spring onions if desired.

recipes.title: Prawn linguine with garlic and chilli
recipes.summary: Quick pasta with prawns, garlic, chilli and fresh parsley.
steps: Cook the linguine in salted boiling water according to package instructions. Drain, reserving 1 cup of pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and chilli and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until pink.
Pour in the white wine and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the cooked linguine to the pan with a splash of pasta water.
Toss everything together, adding more pasta water if needed.
Stir in parsley and lemon zest.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Roasted cauliflower steaks with tahini drizzle
recipes.summary: Thick slices of cauliflower roasted until golden and drizzled with a lemon tahini sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 220°C
Cut cauliflower vertically into 2cm thick steaks
Brush both sides with olive oil and season with cumin, smoked paprika, salt and black pepper
Roast on a baking tray for 20-25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and tender
Meanwhile, whisk together tahini, lemon juice, water and garlic until smooth
Drizzle tahini sauce over cauliflower steaks and garnish with parsley

recipes.title: Spiced cauliflower rice with chickpeas
recipes.summary: Quick stir-fried cauliflower rice with warming spices and chickpeas
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat
Add onion and cook for 3 minutes until softened
Add garlic and cumin seed, cook for 1 minute
Add cauliflower rice, turmeric and salt, stir-fry for 5 minutes
Add chickpeas and cook for 2 minutes until heated through
Garnish with coriander and serve

recipes.title: Cauliflower and potato curry
recipes.summary: A quick weeknight curry with tender cauliflower and potatoes in a spiced tomato sauce
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat
Add onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric and garam masala, cook for 1 minute
Add tinned tomatoes, cauliflower, potatoes, water and salt
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender
Serve hot

recipes.title: Teriyaki chicken with vegetables
recipes.summary: Glazed chicken with crisp vegetables in a sweet and savoury sauce
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over high heat
Add chicken and cook for 5 minutes until browned, then remove
Add remaining oil, red pepper and broccoli, stir-fry for 3 minutes
Mix soy sauce, mirin, sugar, garlic, ginger, cornflour and water
Return chicken to pan, add sauce and cook for 2 minutes until thickened
Garnish with sesame seeds

recipes.title: Baked cod with tomatoes and olives
recipes.summary: Mediterranean-style fish baked with cherry tomatoes, olives and herbs
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Place cod fillets in a baking dish
Scatter cherry tomatoes, olives and garlic around the fish
Drizzle with olive oil and season with oregano, salt and black pepper
Bake for 15-18 minutes until fish is cooked through
Garnish with parsley and serve

recipes.title: Sweet and sour pork
recipes.summary: Crispy pork pieces in a tangy sauce with peppers and pineapple
steps: Toss pork cubes in 2 tbsp cornflour until coated
Heat oil in a large pan and fry pork for 5 minutes until golden, then remove
Add peppers and onion to pan, stir-fry for 3 minutes
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, ketchup, water and remaining cornflour
Add sauce and pineapple to pan, cook for 2 minutes until thickened
Return pork to pan, toss to coat and heat through

recipes.title: Lamb and spinach curry
recipes.summary: Tender lamb in a rich spiced sauce with fresh spinach
steps: Heat oil in a large pot over high heat
Brown lamb pieces for 5 minutes, then remove
Add onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander powder, turmeric and garam masala, cook for 1 minute
Add tinned tomatoes, water, salt and lamb
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes
Stir in spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted

recipes.title: Shrimp linguine with garlic and chilli
recipes.summary: Quick pasta with succulent shrimp, garlic and a touch of heat
steps: Cook linguine in salted boiling water according to package instructions
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat
Add garlic and chilli, cook for 1 minute
Add shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes until pink
Add white wine and simmer for 2 minutes
Drain pasta and add to pan with parsley, lemon zest, salt and black pepper
Toss everything together and serve immediately
recipes.duplicateOf: Prawn linguine with garlic and chilli

recipes.title: Chicken and mushroom stir-fry
recipes.summary: Quick weeknight stir-fry with tender chicken and earthy mushrooms
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan over high heat
Add chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes until cooked through, then remove
Add remaining oil, mushrooms and red pepper, cook for 3 minutes
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornflour and water
Return chicken to pan, add sauce and cook for 2 minutes until thickened
Garnish with spring onions

recipes.title: Baked lemon herb chicken
recipes.summary: Simple roasted chicken pieces with bright lemon and fresh herbs
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Place chicken thighs in a baking dish
Mix olive oil, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt and black pepper
Rub mixture over chicken pieces
Arrange lemon slices around and on top of chicken
Bake for 35-40 minutes until chicken is cooked through and golden
Garnish with parsley and serve

recipes.title: Vegetable fried rice
recipes.summary: Classic fried rice loaded with colourful vegetables
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pan or wok over high heat
Add beaten eggs and scramble, then remove and set aside
Add remaining oil, onion and garlic, cook for 2 minutes
Add red pepper, peas and sweetcorn, stir-fry for 2 minutes
Add cold rice and break up any clumps, stir-fry for 3 minutes
Add soy sauce, sesame oil and scrambled eggs, toss to combine
Garnish with spring onions and serve

recipes.title: Pan-fried sea bass with ginger
recipes.summary: Delicate fish with a fragrant ginger and spring onion dressing
steps: Pat sea bass fillets dry and season with salt
Heat vegetable oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat
Place fillets skin-side down and cook for 3-4 minutes until crispy
Flip and cook for another 2 minutes, then remove to plates
Add ginger to the hot pan and cook for 30 seconds
Add spring onions, soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil, heat through
Pour dressing over fish and serve immediately

recipes.title: Tomato and basil soup
recipes.summary: Simple fresh tomato soup with aromatic basil
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat
Add onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add tinned tomatoes, vegetable stock, sugar, salt and black pepper
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
Tear in basil leaves and blend until smooth
Taste and adjust seasoning before serving

recipes.title: Garlic and chilli king prawns
recipes.summary: Quick tapas-style prawns with plenty of garlic and chilli heat
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat
Add garlic and chillies, cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add prawns and smoked paprika, cook for 3-4 minutes until prawns are pink
Season with salt and add lemon juice
Garnish with parsley and serve immediately

recipes.title: Sticky glazed pork belly
recipes.summary: Tender pork belly with a sweet and savoury glaze
steps: Preheat oven to 160°C
Rub pork belly skin with salt and place in a roasting tin
Roast for 60 minutes
Mix soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger and five spice
Increase oven to 200°C
Brush glaze over pork and roast for 20 minutes
Brush with more glaze and roast for another 10 minutes until sticky and caramelised
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing

recipes.title: Almond-crusted chicken tenders
recipes.summary: Juicy chicken strips coated in almond flour and herbs, baked until golden and crispy
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment
Cut chicken breasts into strips about 2cm wide
Beat eggs in a shallow bowl
In another bowl, mix almond flour, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt and black pepper
Dip each chicken strip in egg, then coat thoroughly in almond mixture
Arrange on baking tray and drizzle with olive oil
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and cooked through, turning halfway

recipes.title: Crispy sesame tofu with stir-fried vegetables
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried tofu cubes tossed with colourful vegetables in a savoury sesame sauce
steps: Press tofu to remove excess water, then cut into 2cm cubes
Toss tofu cubes in cornflour until evenly coated
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a large pan over medium-high heat
Fry tofu until golden on all sides, about 8 minutes, then remove
Cut red pepper into chunks and broccoli into small florets
Add remaining oil to pan, stir-fry vegetables for 4 minutes
Mince garlic and add to pan, cook 1 minute
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil and honey, pour into pan
Return tofu to pan and toss everything together for 2 minutes
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sliced spring onions

recipes.title: Crab and sweetcorn soup
recipes.summary: A silky Chinese-style soup with tender crab meat and sweet corn in a ginger-scented broth
steps: Finely grate ginger and mince garlic
Bring vegetable stock to a simmer in a large pot
Add ginger, garlic and sweetcorn, simmer for 8 minutes
Mix cornflour with water to make a slurry
Stir slurry into soup and simmer for 2 minutes until slightly thickened
Beat eggs lightly, then pour slowly into soup while stirring to create ribbons
Gently fold in crab meat and sesame oil
Season with salt to taste
Garnish with sliced spring onions if desired

recipes.title: Walnut and mushroom bolognese with egg pasta
recipes.summary: A rich, earthy meat-free sauce with walnuts and mushrooms served over fresh egg pasta
steps: Pulse walnuts in a food processor until finely chopped but not paste
Finely dice onion and mince garlic
Chop mushrooms into small pieces
Heat olive oil in a large pan, sauté onion for 5 minutes
Add garlic and mushrooms, cook until mushrooms release their liquid, about 8 minutes
Add chopped walnuts and cook for 2 minutes
Add tinned tomatoes, tomato ketchup and oregano
Simmer sauce for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally
Season with salt and black pepper
Cook egg pasta according to package instructions, drain
Serve sauce over pasta, with parmesan if desired

recipes.title: Grilled scallops with lemon butter
recipes.summary: Sweet, tender scallops seared to perfection and finished with a bright lemon butter sauce
steps: Pat scallops dry with paper towel and season both sides with salt and black pepper
Heat olive oil in a large pan over high heat until very hot
Sear scallops for 2 minutes on each side until golden, then remove to a plate
Reduce heat to medium, add butter to the pan
Mince garlic and add to melted butter, cook for 1 minute
Juice the lemon and add to the butter sauce
Chop parsley and stir into sauce
Return scallops to pan, spoon sauce over them
Serve immediately

recipes.title: Spicy peanut noodles with vegetables
recipes.summary: Quick and satisfying noodles tossed in a creamy peanut sauce with crisp vegetables
steps: Cook rice noodles according to package instructions, drain and set aside
Slice red pepper thinly and julienne carrot
Mince garlic and grate ginger
Mix peanut butter, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, water and chilli powder in a bowl
Heat vegetable oil in a wok over high heat
Stir-fry red pepper and carrot for 3 minutes
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute
Add cooked noodles and peanut sauce, toss everything together for 2 minutes
Slice spring onions and scatter over noodles
Garnish with crushed peanuts if desired

recipes.title: Squid ink risotto
recipes.summary: A dramatic black risotto infused with squid ink and tender pieces of squid
steps: Clean squid and cut bodies into rings, chop tentacles
Heat vegetable stock in a pot and keep warm
Finely dice onion and mince garlic
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large pan, sauté onion for 5 minutes
Add garlic and rice, stir for 2 minutes until rice is translucent at edges
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed
Begin adding stock one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, adding more as each addition is absorbed
After 15 minutes, stir in squid ink
Continue adding stock and stirring for another 10 minutes
Heat remaining oil in a separate pan, quickly sear squid for 2 minutes
Fold cooked squid into risotto
Season with salt and black pepper
Serve with a squeeze of lemon juice and parsley if desired

recipes.title: Pecan-crusted pork chops
recipes.summary: Tender pork chops with a crunchy pecan and herb coating, pan-fried until golden
steps: Finely chop pecans or pulse in a food processor
Mix chopped pecans with dried thyme, garlic powder, salt and black pepper in a shallow dish
Beat egg in another shallow dish
Pat pork chops dry and season both sides with salt and black pepper
Dip each pork chop in egg, then press into pecan mixture to coat both sides
Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat
Cook pork chops for 5-6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through
Let rest for 3 minutes before serving

recipes.title: Clam and tomato linguine
recipes.summary: A coastal Italian classic with clams in a light tomato and white wine sauce
steps: Scrub clams under cold water and discard any that are open
Thinly slice garlic and finely chop red chilli
Heat olive oil in a large pan, add garlic and chilli, cook for 1 minute
Add tinned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes
Pour in white wine and bring to a boil
Add clams, cover the pan and cook for 5 minutes until clams open
Discard any clams that remain closed
Meanwhile, cook linguine according to package instructions, drain
Add drained pasta to the pan with clams and sauce, toss together
Season with salt and chopped parsley

recipes.title: Cashew chicken stir-fry
recipes.summary: A classic Chinese restaurant dish with tender chicken, vegetables and toasted cashews
steps: Cut chicken breast into bite-sized pieces
Toast cashews in a dry pan for 3 minutes, then set aside
Cut red and green peppers into chunks
Mince garlic and grate ginger
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, cornflour and water in a small bowl
Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over high heat
Stir-fry chicken for 5 minutes until cooked through, remove to a plate
Add remaining oil, stir-fry peppers for 3 minutes
Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute
Return chicken to wok, add sauce mixture and cook for 2 minutes until thickened
Stir in toasted cashews and sliced spring onions

recipes.title: Baked halibut with herb butter
recipes.summary: Flaky white fish baked with a rich herb and butter topping
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C
Soften butter and mix with minced garlic, chopped parsley, chopped dill, and lemon zest
Season halibut fillets with salt and black pepper
Place fillets in a baking dish and spread herb butter over each one
Bake for 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily
Serve with lemon wedges

recipes.title: Hazelnut and chocolate brownies
recipes.summary: Rich, fudgy brownies studded with toasted hazelnuts and dark chocolate chunks
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a 20x30cm baking tin with parchment
Roughly chop hazelnuts and toast in a dry pan for 4 minutes
Melt butter and 200g dark chocolate together in a heatproof bowl over simmering water
Chop remaining 100g chocolate into chunks
Beat eggs and sugar together until pale and thick
Fold melted chocolate mixture into eggs
Sift in wheat flour and salt, fold gently
Stir in vanilla extract, chocolate chunks and toasted hazelnuts
Pour into prepared tin and bake for 25 minutes
Let cool completely before cutting into squares

recipes.title: Pistachio and lemon biscotti
recipes.summary: Twice-baked Italian biscuits with pistachios and bright lemon zest
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with parchment
Roughly chop pistachios
Mix wheat flour, baking powder and salt in a large bowl
In another bowl, beat eggs, sugar, lemon zest and vanilla extract
Combine wet and dry ingredients to form a dough
Fold in chopped pistachios
Divide dough in half and shape each into a log about 30cm long and 5cm wide on the baking tray
Bake for 25 minutes until golden and firm
Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes
Using a serrated knife, cut logs diagonally into 1cm thick slices
Lay slices flat on the tray and bake for another 15 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and golden

recipes.title: Mussels in white wine and garlic
recipes.summary: Plump mussels steamed in a fragrant white wine broth with plenty of garlic and herbs
steps: Scrub mussels under cold water, remove beards, and discard any that are open
Finely dice onion and thinly slice garlic
Heat olive oil in a large pot with a lid
Sauté onion for 4 minutes until softened
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
Pour in white wine and bring to a boil
Add mussels, cover pot and steam for 5 minutes, shaking occasionally
Discard any mussels that have not opened
Season with salt, black pepper and chopped parsley
Serve immediately with crusty bread to mop up the broth

recipes.title: Lobster thermidor
recipes.summary: A luxurious French classic with lobster in a rich, creamy mustard sauce topped with cheese
steps: Split cooked lobsters in half lengthwise, remove meat and chop into chunks, reserve shells
Melt butter in a saucepan, stir in wheat flour and cook for 1 minute
Gradually whisk in milk, stirring constantly until smooth
Add cream and simmer gently for 5 minutes until thickened
Stir in dijon mustard and white wine
Remove from heat and whisk in egg yolk
Fold in chopped lobster meat, season with salt and black pepper
Preheat grill to high
Spoon lobster mixture back into the shells
Grate parmesan over the top
Grill for 5 minutes until golden and bubbling
Garnish with parsley if desired

recipes.title: Sticky teriyaki salmon with pak choi
recipes.summary: Pan-fried salmon glazed with homemade teriyaki sauce, served with tender pak choi
steps: Mix soy sauce, mirin, honey, ginger and garlic in a small bowl.
Heat vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add salmon fillets skin-side down and cook for 4 minutes.
Flip salmon and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour teriyaki sauce over salmon and cook for 2 minutes, spooning sauce over fish.
Remove salmon and set aside.
Add pak choi to the pan cut-side down and cook in remaining sauce for 3 minutes until tender.
Serve salmon with pak choi, drizzled with pan sauce and sprinkled with sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Creamy tomato and basil pasta bake
recipes.summary: Comforting baked pasta in a rich tomato cream sauce with melted cheese
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente, drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pan and sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tinned tomatoes, cream and sugar. Season with salt and black pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Tear basil leaves and stir into sauce.
Mix cooked pasta with sauce and transfer to an ovenproof dish.
Top with torn mozzarella and grated parmesan.
Bake for 20 minutes until cheese is golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Beef rendang curry
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked Indonesian beef curry with aromatic spices and coconut milk
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large heavy-based pot over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic and ginger and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander powder, turmeric and chilli powder. Stir for 1 minute.
Add beef and brown on all sides, about 8 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, tamarind paste and palm sugar.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover and simmer for 75 minutes, stirring occasionally, until beef is very tender and sauce has thickened.
Season with salt to taste.
Remove lemongrass stalks before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon drizzle cake
recipes.summary: Classic moist lemon sponge cake with a sweet tangy glaze
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C and grease a 900g loaf tin.
Beat butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Fold in flour, baking powder and lemon zest.
Pour batter into prepared tin and bake for 40 minutes until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
While cake bakes, mix icing sugar with half the lemon juice to make a glaze.
When cake is done, poke holes all over the top with a skewer while still warm.
Pour lemon glaze over the warm cake, letting it soak in.
Leave to cool completely in the tin before turning out.

recipes.title: Chicken katsu curry
recipes.summary: Crispy breaded chicken with Japanese curry sauce and rice
steps: Season chicken breasts with salt and black pepper.
Set up three bowls: flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs.
Coat each chicken breast in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a large frying pan and fry chicken for 6 minutes each side until golden and cooked through. Set aside.
For curry sauce, heat 2 tablespoons oil in a pan and cook onion and carrot for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in curry powder and flour, cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken stock, stirring constantly until smooth.
Add soy sauce and honey, simmer for 10 minutes until thickened.
Slice chicken and serve over rice with curry sauce poured over.

recipes.title: Chocolate chip cookies
recipes.summary: Classic chewy chocolate chip cookies with a crispy edge
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with parchment.
Beat butter, sugar and brown sugar together until creamy.
Add eggs and vanilla extract, beat until combined.
In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking powder and salt.
Gradually fold dry ingredients into wet mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop tablespoons of dough onto prepared trays, spacing 5cm apart.
Bake for 12 minutes until edges are golden but centres still soft.
Leave on tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool.

recipes.title: Vietnamese pho with beef
recipes.summary: Aromatic beef noodle soup with fresh herbs
steps: Heat beef stock in a large pot with star anise, cinnamon stick, cloves and ginger.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook rice noodles according to packet instructions, drain and divide between bowls.
Strain the broth to remove whole spices.
Return broth to pot, add onion and fish sauce, simmer for 5 minutes.
Arrange raw beef slices over noodles in each bowl.
Ladle boiling broth over beef to cook it.
Top with spring onions, bean sprouts, coriander and thai basil.
Serve with lime wedges and sliced chilli on the side.

recipes.title: Cottage pie
recipes.summary: Classic British beef mince topped with creamy mashed potato
steps: Preheat oven to 190°C.
Boil potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a large pan and brown beef mince, breaking it up. Set aside.
In same pan, cook onion and carrots for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Return beef to pan with tomato ketchup, beef stock and worcestershire sauce.
Simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in peas, season with salt and black pepper.
Drain potatoes and mash with butter and milk until smooth.
Transfer beef mixture to an ovenproof dish.
Spread mashed potato evenly over the top.
Bake for 20 minutes until potato is golden.

recipes.title: Spinach and ricotta cannelloni
recipes.summary: Pasta tubes filled with creamy spinach and ricotta, baked in tomato sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Mix ricotta, chopped spinach, egg and half the parmesan in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper and nutmeg.
Fill each cannelloni tube with the ricotta mixture.
Mix passata with garlic and dried oregano, season with salt and black pepper.
Spread half the tomato sauce in the base of an ovenproof dish.
Arrange filled cannelloni tubes in a single layer on top.
Pour remaining tomato sauce over the cannelloni.
Sprinkle with mozzarella and remaining parmesan.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for a further 10 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.title: Tandoori chicken skewers
recipes.summary: Spiced yoghurt-marinated chicken grilled on skewers
steps: Mix yoghurt, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, garam masala, paprika, cumin, turmeric, chilli powder, salt and oil in a large bowl.
Add chicken cubes and coat well in marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 20 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Heat grill or griddle pan to high.
Cook skewers for 12 minutes, turning regularly, until charred and cooked through.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Garlic butter mushrooms on toast
recipes.summary: Sautéed mushrooms in rich garlic butter served on crusty bread
steps: Melt butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes until golden and tender.
Add garlic and thyme, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Stir in chopped parsley.
Spoon mushrooms over toasted bread and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Prawn and vegetable tempura
recipes.summary: Light crispy Japanese battered prawns and vegetables
steps: Heat oil in a deep pan or wok to 180°C.
Make batter by lightly whisking flour, egg and ice-cold water until just combined - it should be lumpy.
Dip prawns and vegetables into batter, letting excess drip off.
Fry in batches for 2-3 minutes until light golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with soy sauce for dipping.

recipes.title: Butternut squash and sage risotto
recipes.summary: Creamy risotto with roasted butternut squash and crispy sage
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Toss butternut squash with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and black pepper. Roast for 30 minutes until tender.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large pan and cook onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and rice, stir for 2 minutes until rice is translucent.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock a ladleful at a time, stirring constantly and waiting until absorbed before adding more, about 20 minutes total.
Meanwhile, fry sage leaves in remaining oil until crispy, about 1 minute. Drain on paper towels.
When rice is creamy and tender, stir in roasted butternut squash, butter and parmesan.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Top with crispy sage leaves to serve.

recipes.title: Roast chicken with root vegetables
recipes.summary: Classic roast chicken with crispy skin and roasted root vegetables
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Pat chicken dry and rub all over with 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt and black pepper.
Place lemon halves and thyme sprigs inside chicken cavity.
Place chicken in a large roasting tin.
Toss potatoes, carrots, parsnips and onion with remaining olive oil, salt and black pepper.
Arrange vegetables around chicken in the roasting tin.
Roast for 75 minutes, basting occasionally, until chicken is golden and juices run clear.
Rest chicken for 10 minutes before carving.
Serve with roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Blackberry crumble
recipes.summary: Sweet-tart blackberries topped with buttery oat crumble
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Mix blackberries with sugar and cornflour in an ovenproof dish.
In a bowl, rub together flour, oats, butter and brown sugar until it resembles breadcrumbs.
Sprinkle crumble mixture evenly over blackberries.
Bake for 35 minutes until golden and fruit is bubbling.
Leave to cool for 10 minutes before serving.
